record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: If a graded ideal J in S contains a regular sequence of homogeneous elements of degrees a1,...,aj and there is a lex-plus-powers ideal L containing x1^a1,...,xj^aj with the same Hilbert function as J, are all Betti numbers of L at least the corresponding Betti numbers of J?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ the polynomial ring with the standard grading $\deg(x_i) = 1$. Order monomials of each degree by the lexicographic order with $x_1 > x_2 > \cdots > x_n$. A monomial ideal $L \subseteq S$ is called a **lex ideal** if, in every degree $d$, the set of monomials of degree $d$ in $L$ is an initial segment under the lex order. Given integers $2 \le a_1 \le a_2 \le \cdots \le a_j$ with $j \le n$, a graded ideal $L \subseteq S$ is called a **lex-plus-powers ideal** (with respect to $a_1, \dots, a_j$) if $L = L' + (x_1^{a_1}, x_2^{a_2}, \dots, x_j^{a_j})$, where $L'$ is a lex ideal.

For a finitely generated graded $S$-module $M$, the **graded Betti numbers** are $\beta_{i,j}^S(M) = \dim_k \mathrm{Tor}_i^S(M,k)_j$.

**Problem.** Let $J \subseteq S$ be a graded ideal that contains a regular sequence of homogeneous elements of degrees $a_1, \dots, a_j$. Suppose $L \subseteq S$ is a lex-plus-powers ideal containing $x_1^{a_1}, \dots, x_j^{a_j}$ that has the same Hilbert function as $J$. Is it true that
$$\beta_{i,j}^S(S/L) \;\ge\; \beta_{i,j}^S(S/J) \qquad \text{for all } i, j \, ?$$
artifact.category_tag: Lex-plus-powers ideals and graded Betti numbers
artifact.status_search_result: The Lex-plus-powers Conjecture (attributed to Evans, with versions by Charalambous–Evans) remains open in general. Substantial partial results are known: Mermin–Murai proved the case where the regular sequence consists of monomials (pure powers); Caviglia–Sammartano (2018) established the conjecture in characteristic zero for regular sequences whose degrees satisfy a growth condition; the almost-complete-intersection case for graded Betti numbers and the case of dimension ≤ 2 are also known. The general conjecture is still unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On the Lex-plus-powers Conjecture (Caviglia–Sammartano)
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the Lex-plus-powers Conjecture in characteristic zero under a growth condition on the degrees of the regular sequence.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture proved in significant new cases, but not in full generality.

status_evidence.title: The Lex-plus-powers conjecture holds for pure powers (Mermin–Murai)
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the conjecture when the regular sequence consists of pure powers of the variables.

status_evidence.title: Lex-plus-powers ideals (Francisco–Richert)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses status of EGH and LPP conjectures and equivalences in low dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: General conjecture remains open; equivalences and low-dimensional cases known.
